removed_packages.reason: S-columns rejected the pre-formatted p-value strings ('$<$0.0001') and parenthesised SEs; the builder now emits plain right-aligned columns.

removed_packages.name: threeparttable

added_packages_layout.name: adjustbox
added_packages_layout.reason: max-width wrapper: shrinks an over-wide table to the text block, leaves narrow tables untouched

added_packages_layout.name: \sloppy + \Urlmuskip
added_packages_layout.reason: absorb residual sub-3pt overfulls into interword stretch; long URLs/paths moved to \url{} so they break
